name: Biuda
what_they_do: Abuja-based youth EdTech startup (Biuda Tech Solutions Limited, led by CEO Patrick Chukwu) teaching coding, Python, AI, web development, UI/UX design, and game development to children and teenagers via live tutor classes, self-paced mobile apps (iOS and Android), mentorship, and school partnerships.
recent_activity: 2026-11-10: Won NGN 5M (~$3,711) non-dilutive grant at the FMYD/NiYA-Cascador Founders Programme Pitch Day (https://techcabal.com/2026/11/10/cascador-niya-select-eight-founders/ | https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/biuda-grant-5m-ngn-e88c610); Ongoing: Running Summer of Tech, Weekend Coding Classes, Olasupo Abideen Partial Scholarship, and Biuda Kids AI-personalized learning app on App Store & Google Play (https://www.biudahq.com/)
investors: Cascador / Nigerian Youth Academy (NiYA) / Federal Ministry of Youth Development
founder_or_marketing_contact: Patrick Chukwu (CEO) | Arinze Nwokolo (Head of Growth and Partnership)
marketing_titles_found: Arinze Nwokolo (Head of Growth and Partnership) on biudahq.com/about
hiring_marketing_role: NO (no careers or open roles page linked on biudahq.com)
unique_offer: AI-personalized K-12 tech education combining live tutor sessions, gamified iOS/Android self-paced coding tracks, student project showcases, and a career personality quiz.
pitch_hook: Biuda has trained 10,000+ young learners and won NGN 5M at NiYA-Cascador on 2026-11-10 with a Head of Growth on team, yet its official site biudahq.com links no Instagram account and hosts no blog to capture organic parent and school search traffic.
